captions.detailed: A Maksutov-Cassegrain catadioptric telescope mounted on a computerized single-arm alt-azimuth mount with a tripod. The main optical tube assembly is a short, thick cylinder colored in off-white, complete with a black finder scope on top and a dark blue primary corrector lens at the front. It is held by a black mounting saddle on a single L-shaped arm. This arm rotates 360 degrees continuously around the vertical azimuth axis, while the telescope tube tilts up and down on a revolute altitude axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Maksutov catadioptric telescope on a single-arm computerized alt-azimuth mount with a tripod. captions.factory: The base tripod is constructed using a central cylinder and three angled cylinder legs with rectangular block feet. The azimuth mount consists of stacked cylinders and an L-shaped arm built from joined boxes. The telescope tube is modeled as a hollowed-out cylinder (using concentric cylinders of slightly different radii) with a blue circular face representing the corrector plate lens, a dark grey rear eyepiece assembly, and a small cylindrical finder scope attached via thin rectangular blocks. A continuous joint connects the tripod base to the L-arm, and a revolute joint connects the L-arm to the telescope saddle.
